mechanism: Ginseng may inhibit CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, potentially increasing sirolimus levels and immunosuppressive effects, while also possessing immunostimulatory properties that could counteract sirolimus's intended immunosuppression.
action: Monitor sirolimus trough levels closely and consider avoiding ginseng use in transplant patients; if concurrent use is necessary, obtain baseline levels and recheck after 2-3 weeks.
